facts.fact: Loi n° 72-18 on the targeting of social support beneficiaries, which creates the Agence nationale des registres, was promulgated by dahir n° 1-20-77 of 8 August 2020 and published in Bulletin officiel n° 6950 on 7 January 2021 (a statute, not a bill).
facts.system: Loi n° 72-18 (Agence nationale des registres; Registre national de la population)

facts.fact: Article 2 of the law defines authentication as checking declared data online and in real time against the Registre national de la population, so identity can be checked electronically against that register.
facts.system: Loi n° 72-18 (Agence nationale des registres; Registre national de la population)

note: The passages file holds only article 2's definition; the implementing decrees (2-20-792, 2-21-473, 2-21-582) are stated as not held, so no applied fact.
